# Mermaid interop matrix (generated)

<!-- Generated by web/src/engine/format/mermaidMatrix.ts — do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate with: MERMAID_MATRIX=1 npx vitest run web/src/engine/format/mermaidMatrix.test.ts -->

PanelCraft converts a documented subset of Mermaid in both directions and
**declares every loss** (SPEC FR-M4/M5): the exporter returns a dropped[] list
and the importer emits M200 diagnostics instead of ignoring lines silently.

## Import / export coverage

| Construct | Import (fromMermaid / fromC4) | Export (docToMermaid / docToC4 / flowToMermaid) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| flowchart / graph | yes | yes | shapes, subgraphs, chained/`&` edges |
| sequenceDiagram | yes (→ flows) | yes (selected flow) | messages, alt/par and notes; import blocks still warn |
| C4Context | yes | yes | Person/System/Container*/Component*, Rel* |
| classDef + class | tags only (colours M100) | yes (from tags) | colours are declared drops |
| linkStyle | yes (→ link style) | partial | stroke/dash mapped; width/index-only lost |
| style | no (M200) | yes (fill only) | use classDef instead |
| click | no (M200) | no | interaction has no PDL counterpart |

## Declared export drops (`docToMermaid`)

Every string below can appear in `dropped[]`; anything starting with
`import ` reports an import that could not be inlined.

- `title`
- `theme`
- `level`
- `direction (auto-layout)`
- `flows`
- `flow descriptions`
- `step descriptions`
- `camera overrides`
- `layout (positions/pins/hides)`
- `descriptions/technology`
- `properties`
- `unknown attributes`
- `icons`
- `object stacking order`
- `decomposition links (drilldown)`
- `embedded source`
- `note anchors (detach)`
- `style beyond fill (stroke/text/shape)`
- `waypoints`
- `system vs container kind distinction (both export as rect)`
- `nested groups (group inside group)`
- `links with group endpoints`

## Declared C4 export drops (`docToC4`)

- `groups (no C4 boundary element)`
- `notes (no C4 annotation element)`
- `flows`
- `layout (positions/pins/hides)`
- `imports (flattened)`
- `link style beyond a label`

## Declared sequence export drops (`flowToMermaid`)

One selected Flow becomes one `.seq.mmd` document. Presentation, animation and
diagram topology stay in PDL; navigation and timing loss are explicit.

- `per-step delays`
- `step descriptions`
- `camera overrides`
- `goto navigation`
- `notes without participants`

## Flow documentation export (`.md`)

`flowMarkdown` / `flowsMarkdown` (UX08-WP14) render the parsed IR — never
flattened playback beats — so the Markdown outline documents everything the
sequence export above has to drop. It is not a Mermaid conversion and is never
re-imported.

| Sequence drop | Documented as |
|---|---|
| `per-step delays` | `dwell <ms> ms` under the step |
| `step descriptions` | italic line under the step |
| `camera overrides` | `camera auto / hold / focus (x, y) zoom z` |
| `goto navigation` | `**Go to** — file#flow (returns here)` |
| `notes without participants` | the step keeps its own text |

## Importer diagnostics

| Code | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `M100` | info | recognised directive with no PDL counterpart (ignored) |
| `M200` | warning | unsupported construct skipped (never silent) |
